## Download

| Your system | File | Install |
|---|---|---|
| Debian 13+, Ubuntu 24.04+ | `janitux_*_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./janitux_*_all.deb` |
| Fedora 40+ | `janitux-*.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./janitux-*.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch Linux | `janitux-*-any.pkg.tar.zst` | `sudo pacman -U janitux-*-any.pkg.tar.zst` |
| Any distribution | `janitux-*.flatpak` | `flatpak install --user janitux-*.flatpak` |
| Any distribution with GTK 4.14+ and libadwaita 1.5+ | `janitux-*.pyz` | `chmod +x janitux-*.pyz && ./janitux-*.pyz` |

`SHA256SUMS` lists the checksums of every file. See the [README](https://github.com/RemoGrillo/janitux#readme) for details.
